job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

- Deep expertise in modern front-end technologies including React, Angular, TypeScript, component libraries, responsive design, and front-end testing frameworks like Jest, Cypress, and Playwright.

- Strong knowledge of front-end performance optimization techniques such as lazy loading, code splitting, tree shaking, caching strategies, and bundle size reduction to deliver fast, responsive GenAI interfaces.

- Experience with front-end state management libraries (Redux, NgRx) for handling complex, data-intensive application states in GenAI applications.

- Proven capability in designing seamless integration between front-end and back-end systems via REST/JSON APIs, GraphQL, and real-time protocols like WebSockets and Server

- Sent Events, including implementation of end-to-end streaming UIs for LLM-powered applications.

- Skilled in driving technical alignment across front-end and back-end teams, ensuring consistency in design patterns, shared components, API contracts, and integration testing strategies.

- Expertise in defining and managing CI/CD pipeline standards for front-end projects using tools like GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins, and experience deploying solutions on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), supported by relevant AI or solution architecture certifications.
